import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_88/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_88/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_88/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_88/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_88/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_88_2 and Source5_88_3 on Ord_id
df = pd.merge(source2, source3, how='inner', left_on='Ord_id', right_on='Ord_id')

# Join the result with Source5_88_0 on Prod_id
df = pd.merge(df, source0, how='inner', left_on='Prod_id', right_on='Prod_id')

# Join the result with Source5_88_1 on Ship_id
df = pd.merge(df, source1, how='inner', left_on='Ship_id', right_on='Ship_id')

# Join the result with Source5_88_4 on Cust_id
df = pd.merge(df, source4, how='inner', left_on='Cust_id', right_on='Cust_id')

# Aggregate Profit by summing all values (no group by columns since target has only Profit column)
result = pd.DataFrame()
result['Profit'] = [df['Profit'].sum()]

# Write the final output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_88/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
